instruction: Save the first blog article titled LLM Powered Autonomous Agents as a PDF in /home/user/Documents/Blog, using the blog post's title for the filename.

metadata.explanation: Task requires saving only the first blog page (about autonomous agents) as a PDF with correct filename. Evaluator checks if the file exists in /home/user/Documents/Blog and contains the expected title text. Partial credit: 0.5 for file exists, 1.0 for correct content. This is simpler than the original task which required saving two blogs.

scoring_breakdown.0.5: PDF file exists but missing correct content
scoring_breakdown.1.0: PDF file exists with correct title content

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies all instruction requirements: file location (/home/user/Documents/Blog), filename (LLM Powered Autonomous Agents.pdf), and content verification
Getter logic properly extracts the needed state: checks file existence via bash command, downloads file using env.controller.get_file(), and extracts PDF text using PyMuPDF
Metric comparison logic is semantically correct: returns 0.0 for missing file, 0.5 for file without correct content, 1.0 for complete success
Partial credit scoring structure aligns well with task requirements and allows meaningful differentiation between partial and complete success
Postconfig includes necessary dependency installation (PyMuPDF) to ensure PDF parsing works at runtime
Error handling is robust with try-except blocks to gracefully handle file reading and PDF parsing failures
Content check string 'LLM Powered Autonomous Agents' correctly matches the expected blog title from the instruction
